Dodaj narezano zelenjavo in 800 ml vode ter kuhaj 20 minut.

Kašo razdeli v sklede in jo obloži z dodatki.
Simmer the rice in the milk for 25 minutes, stirring often.
Add a pinch of salt and a spoonful of sugar.
Chop the fruit and prepare the toppings.
Divide the porridge into bowls and add the toppings.

V loncu na olju 4 minute praži čebulo in česen.
Dodaj narezano zelenjavo, pelate, majaron in 1 l vode.
Kuhaj 20 minut, nato dodaj stročnice (suho lečo dodaj že na začetku).
Kuhaj še 10 minut, posoli in popopraj.
Fry the onion and garlic in oil for 4 minutes.
Add the chopped vegetables, tomatoes, marjoram and 1 l water.
Simmer 20 minutes, then add the pulses (add dried lentils at the start).

Pokrij in pusti vzhajati 1 uro na toplem.
Oblikuj hlebec, žemljice ali ploščo, obloži z dodatki in pusti vzhajati še 20 minut.
Peci v pečici pri 210 °C 20–35 minut, odvisno od velikosti.
Mix the flours, yeast and a teaspoon of salt, add enough lukewarm water (and other liquids) to knead a soft dough.
Cover and leave to rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Shape a loaf, rolls or a flat sheet, add toppings and rise 20 minutes more.
Bake at 210 °C for 20–35 minutes depending on size.

Piščančji file na žaru z zelenjavo z žara
Grilled chicken breast with grilled vegetables
Meso natri z oljem in začimbo za žar ter pusti stati 15 minut.
Zelenjavo pripravi: nareži na rezine in premaži z oljem.
Meso peci na vročem žaru 4–6 minut na vsaki strani, zelenjavo zraven 6–10 minut.
